verdict.rationale: x402 documents a batch-settlement scheme in which agents make thousands of granular paid interactions, and the seller redeems the vouchers together so one onchain transaction can process thousands of payments. That is bulk processing at the settlement layer, but the evidence shows no general-purpose way for a user to run bulk operations across many items, such as bulk payments, refunds or resource management. missing for 10: user-facing bulk operations beyond batched settlement, bulk management of listings/resources or payments, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch settlement (described as still being introduced).
